description: The design phase prompt requires 2-3 explorer subagents but the accepted design ran one or none on both hosts (COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1 SD05) with no cardinality check or warning. Specify the required exploration evidence in the PhaseResult, validate it before accepting the phase, and make the subagent dispatch host-portable instead of Claude Agent/subagent_type semantics. Gap G10.

links.note: Gap G10; SD05 on both hosts
